page.title: 現在形は“いつもの自分”を語る

analysis.summaryJa: 現在形は『今この瞬間』だけでなく、現在を含む習慣・安定した状態・職業や役割、発話と同時に成立する宣言を表す。進行形との対比では、普段の反復や心の状態は現在形、目の前で進行する一時的な動作は進行形として捉える。
grammarPoints: 現在形は習慣・反復する日課を表す
What do you do? は職業・普段の役割を尋ねる
believe・loveなどの思考や感情は通常現在形で表す
promise・apologize・suggestなどは発話自体が行為となる遂行動詞として現在形を使える
現在進行形は今この瞬間の一時的な動作を映す
visualEvidence: 広いPRESENT SIMPLEの時間帯と狭いPRESENT PROGRESSIVEの窓が対比されている
週間カレンダーが現在形の習慣性を示している
内面の感情アイコンが思考・感情を安定状態として示している
発話と行為が同時に成立する図が遂行動詞の現在形を示している
commonTraps: every dayなどの習慣表現なのに進行形を使う
What are you doing? と What do you do? の意味を混同する
believeやloveを必要なく進行形にする
I promiseなどの宣言を未来形にして発話時の行為性を失う
三人称単数主語で現在形の-sを落とす

questions.prompt: Ms. Patel ------- the inventory report every Monday morning.

choices.D: has reviewing

questions.translationJa: パテルさんは毎週月曜の朝に在庫報告書を確認します。
questions.explanationJa: every Monday morningは習慣を示すため現在形を使い、三人称単数主語に合わせてreviewsとします。

questions.prompt: What ------- you do at Northgate Logistics?

choices.D: did now

questions.translationJa: ノースゲート・ロジスティクスではどんな仕事をしていますか。
questions.explanationJa: 職業や普段の役割を尋ねる定型表現はWhat do you do?です。

questions.prompt: The finance director ------- that the revised budget is realistic.

choices.D: believes

questions.translationJa: 財務部長は改訂予算が現実的だと考えています。
questions.explanationJa: believeはここでは継続する考え・状態を表すため通常現在形を使い、単数主語にbelievesを合わせます。

questions.prompt: I ------- for the delay in sending your replacement order.

choices.D: will apologizing

questions.translationJa: 交換品の発送が遅れたことをお詫びします。
questions.explanationJa: apologizeは発話することで謝罪行為が成立する遂行動詞として現在形を使えます。

questions.prompt: The customer service team ------- online inquiries throughout the business day.

choices.D: handled every day now

questions.translationJa: 顧客サービスチームは営業時間中、オンライン問い合わせに対応します。
questions.explanationJa: 通常業務として反復される行為なので現在形handlesが適切です。

questions.prompt: At the moment, our technicians ------- the conference room projector.

choices.D: have test

questions.translationJa: 現在、技術者たちは会議室のプロジェクターをテストしています。
questions.explanationJa: at the momentは今進行中の一時的動作を示すため現在進行形are testingを使います。
questions.focus: 現在形と進行形の対比

questions.prompt: Our regional manager ------- working with international clients.

choices.D: has loving

questions.translationJa: 地域マネージャーは海外顧客と仕事をすることが大好きです。
questions.explanationJa: loveは通常、心に根づく感情状態を表すので現在形lovesを使います。

questions.prompt: I ------- to send the updated itinerary before noon.

choices.D: promise

questions.translationJa: 正午までに更新した旅程を送ることを約束します。
questions.explanationJa: I promiseは発話そのものが約束を成立させるため現在形が自然です。

questions.prompt: Mr. Ito usually ------- the first train when he visits the Osaka branch.

choices.D: has took

questions.translationJa: 伊藤さんは大阪支店を訪れるとき、たいてい始発電車に乗ります。
questions.explanationJa: usuallyは習慣を示す副詞なので現在形takesを使います。

questions.prompt: The notice ------- that all visitors must sign in at reception.

choices.D: has state

questions.translationJa: その掲示には、すべての来訪者が受付で記名しなければならないと書かれています。
questions.explanationJa: 掲示の恒常的な内容を表すため現在形statesを用います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing a regular work habit.

choices.A: Ms. Green is checking supplier invoices every Friday as a permanent routine.
choices.B: Ms. Green has checking supplier invoices every Friday.
choices.C: Ms. Green check supplier invoices every Friday.
choices.D: Ms. Green checks supplier invoices every Friday.

questions.translationJa: グリーンさんは毎週金曜日に仕入先請求書を確認します。
questions.explanationJa: 毎週の習慣は現在形checksで表し、単数主語に-sを付けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence asking about someone's occupation.

choices.A: What are you doing at your company every day as a job?
choices.B: What do you do at your company?
choices.C: What does you do at your company?
choices.D: What you do at your company?

questions.translationJa: 会社ではどんな仕事をしていますか。
questions.explanationJa: 職業・普段の役割を尋ねる基本形はWhat do you do...?です。

questions.prompt: Choose the natural sentence for a stable opinion.

choices.A: I believes the new schedule is more efficient.
choices.B: I am believing the new schedule is more efficient.
choices.C: I believe the new schedule is more efficient.
choices.D: I have believe the new schedule is more efficient.

questions.translationJa: 新しい日程のほうが効率的だと思います。
questions.explanationJa: believeは意見・信念という状態を表すため通常現在形を使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence in which the words themselves perform the action.

choices.B: I am usually apologizing for the inconvenience.
choices.C: I will apologize for the inconvenience yesterday.
choices.D: I apologized for the inconvenience tomorrow.

questions.translationJa: ご不便をおかけしたことをお詫びします。
questions.explanationJa: I apologizeは発話と同時に謝罪行為が成立する典型的な遂行用法です。
questions.focus: 発話行為としての現在形

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence for an action happening right now.

choices.A: The engineer calibrates the sensor right now.
choices.B: The engineer has calibrate the sensor right now.
choices.C: The engineer calibrating the sensor right now.
choices.D: The engineer is calibrating the sensor right now.

questions.translationJa: 技術者は今まさにセンサーを校正しています。
questions.explanationJa: right nowは進行中の動作を示すのでis calibratingが適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the natural sentence expressing a lasting preference.

choices.A: Our director is preferring morning meetings in general.
choices.D: Our director has preferring morning meetings.

questions.translationJa: 部長は午前中の会議を好みます。
questions.explanationJa: preferは一般的な好みという状態を表し、単数主語にはprefersを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct formal declaration made at the moment of speaking.

choices.A: I am confirming every day that the shipment has arrived.
choices.B: I confirm that the shipment has arrived.
choices.C: I confirms that the shipment has arrived.
choices.D: I confirmed tomorrow that the shipment has arrived.

questions.translationJa: 荷物が到着したことを確認します。
questions.explanationJa: I confirmは発話時に確認を正式に表明する遂行的な現在形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence for a repeated customer-service routine.

choices.A: The help desk is answering basic questions every weekday as its normal role.
choices.B: The help desk has answer basic questions every weekday.
choices.C: The help desk answer basic questions every weekday.
choices.D: The help desk answers basic questions every weekday.

questions.translationJa: ヘルプデスクは平日に基本的な質問へ対応します。
questions.explanationJa: 通常の役割として繰り返す業務なので現在形answersが自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly contrasts habit and current action.

choices.A: She normally work at headquarters, but this week she working in Nagoya.
choices.B: She normally is working at headquarters, but this week she works in Nagoya.
choices.C: She normally works at headquarters, but this week she is working in Nagoya.
choices.D: She normally has work at headquarters, but this week she is work in Nagoya.

questions.translationJa: 彼女は普段本社勤務ですが、今週は名古屋で働いています。
questions.explanationJa: 通常の勤務先は現在形works、一時的なthis weekの勤務は進行形is workingで表します。
questions.focus: 習慣と一時的状況の対比

questions.prompt: Choose the natural sentence expressing affection as a stable feeling.

choices.C: Our guests are loving the hotel in a permanent general sense.
choices.D: Our guests have love the hotel.

questions.translationJa: 宿泊客はそのホテルを気に入っています。
questions.explanationJa: 一般的な感情を表すloveは現在形が基本で、複数主語guestsにはloveを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Mr. Bell works from home on Fridays.”

choices.A: Working from home on Fridays is Mr. Bell's regular routine.
choices.B: Mr. Bell is working from home only at this moment on Friday.
choices.C: Mr. Bell worked from home once last Friday.
choices.D: Mr. Bell will work from home on one future Friday only.

questions.translationJa: ベルさんは金曜日には在宅勤務するのが普段の習慣です。
questions.explanationJa: 現在形works on Fridaysは反復する習慣を表すため、regular routineと言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “What do you do?” in a business introduction.

choices.A: What task are you doing at this exact second?
choices.B: What did you do earlier today?
choices.C: What will you do after work?
choices.D: What is your usual job or occupation?

questions.translationJa: 仕事上の自己紹介でのWhat do you do?は『普段どんな仕事をしていますか』という意味です。
questions.explanationJa: 現在形のdoは一時的動作ではなく、安定した職業・役割を尋ねています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I promise to contact you tomorrow.”

choices.A: I am currently contacting you tomorrow.
choices.B: I was making promises repeatedly yesterday.
choices.C: By saying this, I make a promise now that I will contact you tomorrow.
choices.D: I merely describe a past promise that has ended.

questions.translationJa: この発言によって、私は明日連絡するという約束を今ここで成立させています。
questions.explanationJa: 遂行動詞promiseの現在形は、発話そのものが約束行為になります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Ms. Wong believes the proposal is practical.”

choices.A: Ms. Wong is performing a visible believing action right now.
choices.B: Ms. Wong holds the opinion that the proposal is practical.
choices.C: Ms. Wong stopped holding that opinion in the past.
choices.D: Ms. Wong will begin to think about it next year.

questions.translationJa: ウォンさんは、その提案は実用的だという考えを持っています。
questions.explanationJa: believesは安定した意見・心の状態を表しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The store opens at 9:00 every weekday.”

choices.A: Opening at 9:00 is the store's regular weekday schedule.
choices.B: The store is opening only once at 9:00 today.
choices.C: The store opened at 9:00 on one unspecified past day.
choices.D: The store has never had a fixed opening time.

questions.translationJa: その店は平日は毎日9時開店という通常スケジュールです。
questions.explanationJa: 現在形opensとevery weekdayは恒常的な営業時間を表します。
questions.focus: 現在形と定期スケジュール

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I apologize for the confusion.”

choices.A: I am describing someone else's apology.
choices.B: I will perhaps apologize at some future time.
choices.C: My saying these words constitutes an apology now.
choices.D: I apologized only in the distant past.

questions.translationJa: この言葉を述べること自体が、今の謝罪になります。
questions.explanationJa: I apologizeは遂行動詞の現在形で、発話と行為が一致します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The analysts are reviewing the figures now.”

choices.A: Reviewing figures is their permanent job description only.
choices.B: They review the figures every month as a routine.
choices.C: They finished reviewing the figures yesterday.
choices.D: The review is in progress at this moment.

questions.translationJa: 分析担当者たちは今この瞬間、数値を確認している途中です。
questions.explanationJa: are reviewing nowは現在進行中の動作を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Our manager prefers written updates.”

choices.A: Written updates are our manager's usual preference.
choices.B: Our manager is temporarily performing the action of preferring.
choices.C: Our manager preferred written updates only yesterday.
choices.D: Our manager has no stable preference.

questions.translationJa: 部長は通常、書面での更新報告を好みます。
questions.explanationJa: prefersは一般的・安定した好みを示す現在形です。
questions.focus: 現在形と安定した好み

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “She usually takes the subway to work.”

choices.A: She is on the subway at this exact second necessarily.
choices.B: Taking the subway is her normal way of commuting.
choices.C: She took the subway once and never again.
choices.D: She will start commuting sometime in the future.

questions.translationJa: 地下鉄で通勤するのが彼女の通常の通勤方法です。
questions.explanationJa: usually＋現在形は反復習慣を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I confirm receipt of your payment.”

choices.A: I am predicting that payment may arrive.
choices.B: I once confirmed a different payment.
choices.C: With this statement, I formally acknowledge that your payment was received.
choices.D: I am describing a repetitive physical action.

questions.translationJa: この発言によって、あなたの支払いを受領したことを正式に確認します。
questions.explanationJa: confirmの現在形は、通知文などで発話・記述そのものが確認行為になります。

questions.prompt: The reception desk opens at 8:30 each weekday. Ms. Diaz ------- there before most employees arrive.

choices.D: has usually working

questions.translationJa: 受付は平日8時30分に開きます。ディアスさんは通常、ほとんどの社員が来る前からそこで勤務しています。
questions.explanationJa: 文脈は平日の通常業務を述べているためusually worksが適切です。

questions.prompt: “Nice to meet you. I’m Ken from purchasing.” “Likewise. What ------- you do in the Tokyo office?”

choices.D: do

questions.translationJa: 『はじめまして。購買のケンです』『こちらこそ。東京オフィスではどんな仕事をしていますか』
questions.explanationJa: 自己紹介の流れでは職業・役割を尋ねるWhat do you do...?が自然です。
questions.focus: 会話文でのWhat do you do?

questions.prompt: The shipment is delayed, and the client is concerned. I ------- to call the client as soon as we receive an update.

choices.D: have promise

questions.translationJa: 荷物が遅れており、顧客は心配しています。更新情報を受け取り次第、顧客へ電話すると約束します。
questions.explanationJa: その場で約束を成立させる発話なのでI promiseが適切です。

questions.prompt: Our legal adviser has reviewed the contract. She ------- that the revised clause is acceptable.

questions.translationJa: 法務顧問は契約書を確認済みです。彼女は改訂条項は受け入れ可能だと考えています。
questions.explanationJa: 現在の意見・判断という状態なのでbelievesを使います。

questions.prompt: Normally, the support team handles requests by email. Today, however, they ------- customers by phone because the email system is down.

choices.D: are contacting

questions.translationJa: 通常、サポートチームはメールで依頼に対応します。しかし今日はメールシステム停止のため、電話で顧客に連絡しています。
questions.explanationJa: Normallyの習慣とTodayの一時的状況を対比しているのでare contactingが適切です。
questions.focus: 習慣と一時的進行の対比

questions.prompt: The board members have considered both options. Most of them ------- the second proposal because it reduces operating costs.

choices.D: has prefer

questions.translationJa: 取締役たちは両案を検討しました。大半は運営費を削減できるため第2案を好んでいます。

questions.prompt: The ceremony is beginning now. The host says, “I ------- everyone to our annual awards dinner.”

choices.D: am welcoming usually

questions.translationJa: 式典が今始まります。司会者は『皆さまを年次表彰ディナーへ歓迎します』と言います。
questions.explanationJa: I welcomeは式典などで発話と同時に歓迎行為を成立させる現在形です。

questions.prompt: Mr. Chen works in accounting, but this month he ------- the audit team with a special project.

choices.D: is assisting

questions.translationJa: チェンさんは経理部勤務ですが、今月は特別案件で監査チームを支援しています。
questions.explanationJa: 恒常的な所属worksに対しthis monthは一時的状況なのでis assistingを使います。

questions.prompt: The product manual explains the standard procedure. It ------- users to restart the device after installing the update.

choices.B: is instructing at this second only

questions.prompt: “Why are you smiling?” “I ------- this new office. The view is excellent.”

choices.D: have loving

questions.explanationJa: loveは感情状態を表すため、標準的には現在形loveを使います。
